events.title: 웨인 루니 , at 18 years of age, leaves 에버턴 for 맨체스터 유나이티드 in a £27 million deal, a world record for a teenager. He joins a United side who have finished the first month of the league season in ninth place. Meanwhile, the Premier League leaders are defending champions 아스널 who are level on points with second-placed 첼시 – both have won all four games so far this season. 볼턴 원더러스, 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 미들즈브러 complete the top five. 크리스털 팰리스, 블랙번 로버스 and 노리치 시티 complete the bottom three. In the newly named Football League Championship , 위건 애슬레틱 are top of the table and level on points with 스토크 시티 . 입스위치 타운 , who lost in the playoffs last season, occupy third place. 플리머스 아가일 , newly promoted and at this level for the first time in 13 years, stand fourth. Reading and 셰필드 유나이티드 complete the top six.

events.title: 첼시 win the Premiership, their first top-flight title in 50 years, with a 2–0 victory over Bolton at the Reebok Stadium. 프랭크 램퍼드 scored both goals. The race for second place is now being contested between 아스널 and 맨체스터 유나이티드, with 아스널 having the advantage of one point and a game in hand. 에버턴, 리버풀, 볼턴 원더러스 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 complete the top seven, as the FA Cup will (like the League Cup final was) be a top-five affair this season seventh place in the league will be enough for a UEFA Cup place this time. 미들즈브러, 맨체스터 시티 and 애스턴 빌라 are still in contention for a UEFA Cup place on these grounds. 노리치 시티, 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and 크리스털 팰리스 occupy the bottom three places, with 사우샘프턴 out of the bottom three only due to having a slightly better goal difference than 크리스털 팰리스. 선덜랜드 will be back in the Premier League next season after a two-year exile, being in pole position at the top of the Championship. 위건 애슬레틱 and 입스위치 타운 are in the race for second place. 프레스턴 노스 엔드, 더비 카운티 and Reading complete the top six, but 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 셰필드 유나이티드 are still in contention for the playoff places. Away from the Championship promotion race, 코번트리 시티 assure their Championship survival in style with a 6–2 win over 더비 카운티 in the last ever game at Highfield Road , which they are leaving after 106 years to relocate to the 32,500-seat Ricoh Arena . A crowd of 22,728 watched the game.

If Fowler had converted, 맨체스터 시티 would have gone to the UEFA Cup instead of the Teessiders .

events.title: 크리스털 팰리스 , 노리치 시티 and 사우샘프턴 are relegated from the Premiership on the last day of the season, finishing 18th, 19th and 20th respectively. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 , which started the day at the bottom of the table, complete an improbable escape to become the first club since the creation of the Premier League in 1992–93 to survive after being the bottom team at Christmas. Their survival was achieved with a 2–0 home win over 포츠머스, while 크리스털 팰리스 had been less than ten minutes from safety when 찰턴 애슬레틱 equalised against them. 노리치 시티 could have saved themselves regardless of what happened to the other three teams had they won at 풀럼, but instead were hammered 6–0 in the showdown at Craven Cottage . 사우샘프턴's survival bid ended with a 2–1 home defeat by 맨체스터 유나이티드, drawing the curtain on 27 successive seasons of top-flight football at the club.

events.text: UEFA가 이스탄불 결승 뒤 두 감독의 반응을 전했다. 리버풀은 세 골 차를 따라잡았고 밀란은 우승 기회를 놓쳤다.

events.text: 리버풀이 밀란에 전반 0–3으로 뒤진 뒤 후반 세 골을 따라잡았다. 연장전 뒤 승부차기에서 승리하며 유럽 챔피언이 됐다.

events.title: 리버풀 win the European Cup for a fifth time, beating AC 밀란 3–2 on penalties after extra time. AC 밀란 went ahead 3–0 in the first half, but 리버풀 scored three goals in the first 15 minutes of the second half to level the score.

events.title: At Atatürk Olympic Stadium in Istanbul , 리버풀 F.C. scores three goals in six minutes to tie the game and after extra-time goes on to defeat AC 밀란 3-2 in a penalty shootout to win its first UEFA Champions League title since 1984 . Goals from 스티븐 제라드 , Vladimír Šmicer and 샤비 알론소 levelled he game in the second half.리버풀 eventually winning 3-2 on penalties In one of the greatest comebacks in sporting history

events.title: UEFA changes the rules for the UEFA Champions League to ensure that the reigning champions will always be able to defend their title. The immediate effect is to allow 리버풀 to defend their crown, despite a fifth-place finish in the Premiership, outside the four slots currently allotted for England in the competition. 리버풀 will have to begin play in the first of three qualifying rounds.
